fields.description_1: GS Privechauffeur needed a private driver website that feels professional, clear and trustworthy from the first visit. Visitors had to understand the service, when to use it and how to request more information without unnecessary friction.
fields.description_2: I created a page structure with concise service information, clear benefits and visible contact options. The final WordPress page presents the private driver service in a calm and reliable way, making it easier for visitors to compare and enquire.

fields.description_1: Businesssuites had useful office-rental information, but the message needed a calmer structure and clearer priority. Visitors needed to scan the page, understand the practical value, and see a simple route forward. The content also had to sound specific instead of broad or interchangeable. It made the next step clearer sooner.
fields.description_2: I rewrote the content and organised the page so each section answers a clear visitor question. The result explains the office-rental work in plain English, connects benefits to real decisions, and keeps contact options close. This makes the case easier to read, compare, and trust. It made choices easier too.

fields.description_1: Ibtraject needed a website that answers practical visitor questions faster. The engineering offer had to be explained with clear context, useful detail and a visible route to contact. Without a tighter structure, the page risked feeling generic and harder to judge on smaller screens.
fields.description_2: I refined the page by reducing repetition, improving the order of information and making each section easier to scan. The WordPress build presents the engineering offer with practical context and a steady flow, giving visitors clearer reasons to compare the work and start a conversation.

fields.description_1: The politics page for Monitorpolitiekeontwikkeling needed to remove hesitation before inquiry. Visitors were likely comparing providers, so the page had to explain the work quickly, show relevant details, and keep the next step obvious. Long, general wording would have made the offer feel less certain. It made choices easier too.
fields.description_2: I created a more direct page flow with concise headings, specific project wording, and WordPress content fields that stay easy to maintain. The design gives Monitorpolitiekeontwikkeling a clearer presentation, while visitors can scan the work, understand the value, and move toward contact without confusion. It supported faster decisions before contact.

fields.description_1: Kroessvisser needed a finance page that removes hesitation before inquiry. Visitors were likely comparing providers, so the page had to explain the offer quickly, show relevant details and keep the next step clear. Long or general wording would have made the service feel less certain.
fields.description_2: I created a more direct page flow with concise headings, specific project wording and WordPress content fields that remain easy to maintain. The design gives Kroessvisser a clearer presentation, while visitors can scan the offer, understand the value and move towards contact without confusion.

fields.description_1: The need for an improved webshop was required for Superfruitmand as the visitors were unable to comprehend what Superfruitmand had to offer or what was in it for them. With more details regarding the projects being shown, there would be a better understanding of how Superfruitmand could be of use.
fields.description_2: I refined Superfruitmand with better WordPress architecture, more precise English writing, and a design that takes users from information to action without any distractions, along with enhanced project context for visitors evaluating the project prior to contacting them, superior structure, clear wording, and concise writing.

fields.description_1: A progress that was needed in terms of the page content included making it more understandable and convenient for comparing options offered. The page needed to provide information on the recruitment process in an easily understandable manner, which at the same time would give a sufficient amount of information about the service and encourage contact.
fields.description_2: I structured the page based on the priority information that the visitors should have: the offer, the advantage, and what to do next. Concise sections, clearer writing style, and efficient WordPress distribution have facilitated the evaluation of the recruiting project. The page became more concrete, practical, and inquiry-friendly.

fields.description_1: The website for Bedrijfsboekhouder had to show entrepreneurs that bookkeeping can be simpler and less stressful. Visitors needed to understand which tasks they could outsource, what collaboration looks like, and when professional support can help their business.
fields.description_2: The site is built around realistic questions entrepreneurs often have about administration, tax returns, and financial advice. The text is direct and guides visitors toward the next step: getting in touch for more information. This helps entrepreneurs see what is offered without having to compare everything themselves.

fields.description_1: For the PRO Metaal recycling website, it was important to eliminate any uncertainty prior to an inquiry. The visitor was probably looking at various options, hence it was crucial that the work involved be stated clearly and the next step be made evident. Uncertainty would definitely have been reduced by concise and specific language used.
fields.description_2: I streamlined the page structure using succinct headings, precise terminology, and content fields from WordPress that would always be simple to update. This helped to give PRO Metaal a more professional image, while allowing users to easily view their portfolio, comprehend the benefits of their services, and then get in touch with them.
